args.command: find . -type f | head -50; echo '---'; cat README.md NOTES.md

args.content:
"""Command line entry point: python -m textstats FILE"""
import sys

from .core import count_words, longest_word, top_words


def main(argv=None):
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if len(argv) != 1:
        print("usage: python -m textstats FILE", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with open(argv[0], encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()
    print(f"words: {count_words(text)}")
    print(f"longest word: {longest_word(text)}")
    print(f"top words: {top_words(text)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
